semantics.process_p50_ms: median/min/max of six process medians; values are in process-round order
semantics.process_p95_ms: median/min/max of six process p95 values; this is not pooled p95
semantics.pooled_600_samples_ms: linear-interpolated p50/p95 of all 600 uninstrumented samples, ignoring process grouping
semantics.corpus: Sum of corresponding per-row sample indexes; not wall time of a manifest-order corpus sweep
semantics.cold_phases: Fresh-process load/setup phases as defined by each engine; setup work differs. Session preparations are separate and may occur later.
semantics.first_call: One first measured call before 30 warmups, per row. Later rows may reuse buffers from earlier rows.
semantics.rust_allocations: Three separate allocator-instrumented processes. Successful allocation/reallocation count and requested bytes; retained/peak heap growth are relative to each phase baseline. Peak includes transient staging.
semantics.csharp_allocations: Current-thread managed allocation volume only; no native allocation count or retained/transient heap peak measurement
semantics.activation: Recorded planned/retained F32 activation buffers, excluding model weights; phase and whole-process residency are separate metrics
semantics.rss: Parent-sampled OS high-water resident memory, including startup/validation/corpus/model/runtime; can miss the last observation. Not activation bytes or allocator peak.
semantics.mixed_shapes: One session follows the recorded 14-shape sequence each call. Total latency includes reshape and graph work; reshape-only samples are reported separately.
semantics.conclusion_scope: Recorded corpus, build and environment only; no universal speedup claim

contract.public_classifier_semantics: C# Classify: compatible bias-first head/logit argmax, separate from dense Softmax probabilities; strict score > threshold rotation.
contract.scope: Detection, ordered boxes, perspective crops, classifier and oriented recognition pixels; no recognition graph or text.

input.origin: sample.jpg rotated 180 degrees from frozen decoded bytes

measurement_semantics: Per-row contiguous first/warmup/measured blocks; corpus samples sum corresponding indexes, not wall sweeps. Canonical serial scalar. Graph calls copy external inputs through the span overload. Mixed calls include reshape on one session. Pipeline uses public C# detector/classifier (classifier uses its compatible prefix head), reused crop bytes, and owning detection boxes. Load covers model stream read/import; prepare covers benchmark row inputs/sessions and detector/classifier setup. Validation is outside both phases. No tracing, hashes, file I/O or serialization during warm timing.
process_memory_semantics: Parent sampled child OS high-water resident memory; includes validation, model loading, corpus and runtime. Excludes no startup phase and can miss the final observation. Not a tensor or managed/native heap peak.

measurement_semantics: Per-case timed blocks; corpus samples sum matching sample indexes, not manifest-order wall sweeps. Input copying included in graph and mixed-shape calls. Pipeline preprocesses directly into session input; no tracing/hashing/file I/O in timed calls. Node profiling is a separate observer-instrumented mode. Owned-result copy mode includes dropping the copied result.
process_memory_semantics: Parent sampled child OS high-water resident memory; includes validation, model loading, corpus and runtime. Excludes no startup phase and can miss the final observation. Not a tensor or managed/native heap peak.

activation_memory_semantics: Persistent extractor plus maximum simultaneously live additional benchmark sessions; excludes shared weights, source corpus, image scratch and timing metadata. Mixed-shape additional session counters describe the final binding and retained capacities. Public CLS retains the same full binding as its dense graph session.
preparation_semantics: load covers model loading/compilation. prepare covers persistent extractor construction. session_preparations separately covers each additional measured graph or stage binding; source corpus decoding/validation is outside these phases.

rust_allocations.instrumentation: separate allocator-instrumented executable; exclude these timings

zero_allocation_gate.scope: Each prepared fixed-input row's 100 measured calls, after first call and 30 warmups.
